ehr.name: CareFlow EHR Search
ehr.description: Grounded search over synthetic encounter data. Returns exact records and explicit not-found results without inventing patient facts.

analytics.name: CareFlow Healthcare Analytics
analytics.description: Deterministic healthcare operations statistics, comparisons, rankings, billing summaries, and cohort metrics.

triage.name: CareFlow Administrative Triage
triage.description: Reports recorded acuity, review, and escalation fields for administrative routing. It does not diagnose or infer clinical thresholds.

documents.name: CareFlow Document Generator
documents.description: Creates administrative review packages, discharge summaries, and accounting PDFs from grounded specialist data.

workspace.name: CareFlow Workspace Actions
workspace.description: Prepares external Workspace actions behind explicit approval. Google execution remains disabled unless deployment secrets explicitly enable it.

compliance.name: CareFlow Compliance and Audit
compliance.description: Checks recorded communication consent and guardian requirements and writes append-only workflow decision evidence.

supervisor.name: CareFlow AI Hospital Operations Supervisor
supervisor.description: ASI:One-powered supervisor that turns hospital operations goals into adaptive specialist plans, streams progress, requests human approval through interactive cards, and produces audited review outcomes.
